metadata.description: OnlyCopilotFans plugins for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central AL development.

plugins.name: ocpf-bc
plugins.description: The OnlyCopilotFans Business Central Agentic Development Framework: a guided DEFINE, DESIGN, BUILD, PROVE routine for building AL extensions the right way, per-tenant or for AppSource. Picks Full, Lite, or Build-a-Feature (one object or a few, no steps, no documents), sets up the latest runbook, connects Microsoft's AL tools with nothing to install, adds reasoning, light, and generator sub-agents, writes every project document from a template, measures token usage and cost at every step boundary, and keeps a live HTML dashboard of the build.
